items.title: 68190_Samuel
items.q: Marty Napoleon said the same thing. When he came through it was Chico Marx's band, played the mule box.

ctx.x: Any musician that come through Kansas City during the late '20s and the early '30s, if he hadn't played and jammed at the Sunset, well he really hadn't been to Kansas City. It was just that simple. He had to come to the Sunset because that's where it was happening.
Marty Napoleon said the same thing. When he came through it was Chico Marx's band, played the mule box.
All guys that come through here I don't care how great they were, they would be at the Sunset.
